Overview.Name: Kodakanchi Jagadeesh
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & vegetable dosa (1)
Option 2: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer cubes (50 g)
Option 3: Vegetable upma (medium bowl) & boiled egg (1)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (palm size) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & dal (1 bowl) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & grilled chicken (moderate portion) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Chicken stir fry (light portion) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Since you do field work, keep meals filling but simple so energy stays steady throughout the day.
Include chicken mainly at lunch to support strength and recovery.
Stress can increase hunger, so keep makhana or boiled eggs ready instead of fried snacks.
Keep dinner lighter to support good digestion and sleep.
Simple pan fried or grilled cooking will help you stay consistent daily.
